stage.name: s2_3s_critic
stage.notes: 2.3c with appetite learning from dopamine (look and pallium -> valence_app under da, the mirror of the aversive side) and pain reaching the habenula through us_pain; control the 2.2 brain

no_plasticity.why: how much of the fitness needs learning within a life

pallium.why: the code the critic and the learned aversion read

us_taste.why: the taste the dopamine cell compares with its prediction

value_app.why: does the prediction of good things pay

value_av.why: does the prediction of bad things pay

habenula.why: tonic: needed, but its lesion leaves a standing error (not a pure measure of use)

dopamine.why: tonic: needed, but its lesion leaves a standing error (not a pure measure of use)

ventral_pallidum.why: tonic: the fast path of good predictions; a standing error when silenced

gp_habenular.why: tonic: the fast path of bad predictions; a standing error when silenced

learn_off:valence_app.why: the new appetite learning from dopamine: is it used

learn_off:valence_av.why: its mirror, the aversion learning: for comparison

reversal_life.ylabel: bites per 100 creatures alive, per tick
reversal_life.caption: Recorded lives of the last generation of every seed (64 creatures, two worlds each); dashed: share of the creatures still alive (right axis).

columns: Chance of a bite with the bush at the mouth
rows: A former poison, before the switch
A former poison, after the switch
A former food, before the switch
A former food, after the switch
reversal_bites.caption: From the same recorded lives.

columns: Input drive of the aversive cells
rows: Aversion to a bush after 6 painful meals
... after 12 more meals of it without pain (extinction)
Aversion to a second cue paired with pain next to a known one (blocking)
... next to a cue that predicted nothing (control)
conditioning_lab.caption: Lab test on 24 creatures of the last generation of every seed: a new look shown at the mouth, three bites with pain (or none), then four ticks of nothing; read out from a rested brain, learning off. The drive is the input of the aversive cells before their ceiling.

dopamine_shift.caption: The critic's error on every tick of a trial, mean of 24 creatures of the last generation of every seed. Negative: worse than expected.
